name: exam-loop
description: Prepare for college exams with course-scoped practice, feedback, a persistent learning record, and review guides.

defaultPrompt: Get me started with ExamLoop and show me how to study efficiently.
Check my practice answers and turn my mistakes into targeted questions.
Use my course outline and past exams to build a practice exam with a separate answer key.
